items.prompt: When a situation in real life repeats the same fraction, we can model it as a multiplication. For example: one serving of trail mix uses two thirds 2/3 cup of nuts. How many cups are needed for five servings?
items.demo: Five servings, each using two thirds of a cup 2/3 cup, so I write five times two thirds. *5 × 2/3*
